description: Flask-style service with the classic web weaknesses, one per route. Hermetic fixture.

vulnerabilities.description: User-controlled name is interpolated into a SQL string via an f-string.
User-controlled host is concatenated into a shell command run with shell=True.
Request-controlled file name is joined onto the upload directory and served; '..' escapes it.
Server fetches an attacker-supplied URL with no allowlist.
pickle.loads() on the raw request body.
Passwords are hashed with unsalted MD5.
eval() on its argument in a third-party snippet checked into the tree.
vulnerabilities.note: Expected to be lost at the noise filter: third_party paths are excluded by default. Kept deliberately to exercise that loss point; delete it if you decide vendored code is out of scope.
